description: Jest 30.5.2's text for a describe that holds only hooks beside a test: the test runs, and the file fails with one `Invalid: <hook>() may not be used in a describe block containing no tests.` per hook under `Test suite failed to run`, with no class name before it. Kept: every stderr line that is not a stack frame, a code frame, a test list line (those carry durations), a time, a count line or runner noise. A black-box run, read by `provino`'s `jest-uncaught.test.ts`.

run.keepLines: ^(?!\s+at )(?!ERROR: failed)(?!\(node:)(?!\(Use )(?!\s+[✓✕○])(?!\s+hooks without tests$)(?!\s+>?\s*\d+ \|)(?!\s+\| +\^)(?!Time:)(?!Ran all)(?!Test Suites:)(?!Tests:)(?!Snapshots:)(?!Test results)(?!\s*$)
